serviceData.title: Plant & Refractory Maintenance
serviceData.description: Specialized maintenance including refractory installations, plant shutdown coordination, and process optimization for mining clients. With extensive experience at Glencore Lion Smelter and Xstrata, our team ensures minimal downtime and maximum operational efficiency.
serviceData.details: LAPS Projects and Logistics provides comprehensive plant maintenance and refractory services to major mining operations across South Africa. Our expertise includes refractory installations during scheduled plant shutdowns, process optimization, emergency repairs, and full plant coordination. With our director Maven Malapane's experience as former Process Superintendent at Glencore Lion Smelter and Process Coordinator at Xstrata, we bring unmatched expertise to every project. We ensure that all plant shutdowns are completed safely, on time, and within budget, with detailed handover documentation to enable smooth restart of operations.
serviceData.goalDescription: Our goal is to deliver reliable, cost-effective plant maintenance solutions that extend equipment life, optimize production output, and maintain the highest safety standards.
goalList: Preventive maintenance programs tailored to client needs
24/7 emergency response capabilities for urgent repairs
Certified refractory installation specialists
Zero downtime approach to planned plant shutdowns
Comprehensive safety compliance with OHSAS 18001 standards
Detailed documentation and handover after each project

serviceData.title: Fuel Management Systems
serviceData.description: Expert maintenance and installation of TMM fuel systems for major mines including Dwarsrivier and Samancor ECM. Our team ensures reliable fuel system performance to prevent costly downtime.
serviceData.details: We specialize in the maintenance, installation, and calibration of Trackless Mobile Machinery (TMM) fuel systems for underground and surface mining operations. As a current subcontractor at Dwarsrivier Mine and Samancor ECM since January 2024, we provide regular preventive maintenance, emergency repairs, system calibration, and staff training. Our team ensures that all fuel systems operate reliably, preventing costly downtime and maintaining safety compliance with mine regulations. We pride ourselves on rapid response times and minimizing operational disruptions for our clients.
serviceData.goalDescription: To ensure reliable fuel system performance that prevents unplanned downtime, maintains safety standards, and optimizes equipment efficiency.
goalList: Regular preventive maintenance schedules tailored to mine operations
Emergency repair services available 24/7
System calibration and performance optimization
Staff training on basic system checks and reporting
Comprehensive safety compliance with mine regulations
Rapid response to minimize operational disruptions

serviceData.title: Civil & HDPE Construction
serviceData.description: Professional civil works including HDPE pipe installations, concrete supply, building, plumbing, and infrastructure development for mining and industrial clients.
serviceData.details: We provide end-to-end civil construction services for mining and industrial clients across South Africa. Our expertise includes HDPE pipe installations for water and slurry transport, concrete supply for infrastructure projects, building construction, plumbing services, and general infrastructure development. Recent projects include HDPE pipe installations at Samancor ECM, where we delivered high-quality work while minimizing disruption to active mining operations. Our team ensures all civil works meet rigorous industry standards and client specifications.
serviceData.goalDescription: To deliver high-quality civil construction services that meet rigorous industry standards, client specifications, and safety requirements.
goalList: HDPE pipe installation and welding for water and slurry transport
Concrete supply and casting for infrastructure projects
Building construction and general maintenance
Plumbing services for industrial facilities
Infrastructure development for local communities
Quality assurance on all completed projects

serviceData.title: Environmental & Waste Services
serviceData.description: Hazardous waste cleaning, collection of contaminated water, sludge, dirty oil, and vegetation control services for mining operations.
serviceData.details: LAPS Projects and Logistics offers comprehensive environmental management services to help mining operations maintain compliance with environmental regulations. We specialize in hazardous waste cleaning, collection of contaminated water, sludge, and dirty oil, as well as vegetation control services. Our commitment to environmental responsibility ensures minimal impact throughout our operations, and we work closely with clients to develop sustainable solutions that protect natural resources. We ensure all waste is disposed of properly in accordance with environmental regulations.
serviceData.goalDescription: To provide environmentally responsible waste management solutions that protect natural resources, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote sustainability.
goalList: Hazardous waste collection and proper disposal
Contaminated water and sludge removal services
Dirty oil collection and recycling programs
Vegetation control and chemical application
Environmental compliance monitoring and reporting
Sustainable practices that minimize environmental impact

serviceData.title: Underground Mining Support
serviceData.description: Underground sweepings, clearing services, and processing of scats to separate steel for recycling and recovery.
serviceData.details: We provide specialized underground support services to maintain safe and efficient mining operations. Our services include underground sweepings and clearing, processing of scats to separate steel for recycling and recovery, and general material handling. Our team works in challenging underground environments, maintaining high safety standards while delivering reliable support services that help mines operate efficiently. We focus on maximizing resource recovery while minimizing waste, contributing to sustainable mining practices.
serviceData.goalDescription: To support mining operations with reliable underground services that enhance safety, improve efficiency, and maximize resource recovery.
goalList: Underground sweeping and clearing services
Scat processing and steel recovery for recycling
Material handling and transport underground
Safety-focused operations with strict compliance
24/7 support availability for mining operations
Efficient resource recovery and waste reduction

serviceData.title: Plant Hire & Fabrication
